tools.name: x402_preflight
tools.description: Should an agent pay this x402 endpoint? Pre-payment check of an UNKNOWN x402 URL: fetch it once (never pays) to validate the 402 challenge + accepts[] (scheme/network/payTo/amount/asset/resource = will it settle) AND label its LIVENESS (LIVE | ZOMBIE | DEAD — is it a working payable endpoint right now, or listed-active-but-broken) AND flag an absolute PRICE TRAP (a honeypot charging >= $1,000/call trips AVOID even when its advertised==live price looks self-consistent; pass max=<usdc> for your own budget ceiling) AND scan the resource + any advertised MCP tools for LLM01/LLM08 prompt-injection and screen payTo against the OFAC SDN + community scam lists (safe to pay) AND verify the PRICE — does the live accepts[].amount match the advertised price? pass advertised=<usdc> (the figure your catalog quoted) or it self-checks the endpoint's /.well-known/x402: MATCH | OVERCHARGE | UNDERCHARGE. Optional samples=N (1-5) runs a reliability/payability burst (settle-consistency + latency; a flapping endpoint downgrades PAY to CAUTION). Returns verdict PAY | CAUTION | AVOID + per-check fix hints + latency. Read-only, never a settlement guarantee. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on MCP tools/call (direct HTTP route: $0.001).

url.description: the x402 endpoint URL to pre-check before paying

advertised.description: optional: the price (USDC dollars, e.g. 0.001) your catalog/listing quoted — returns MATCH/OVERCHARGE/UNDERCHARGE vs the live accepts[].amount; omit to self-check against the endpoint's own /.well-known/x402

max.description: optional: your per-call budget ceiling in USDC dollars (e.g. 0.05) — the result flags price_trap.exceeds_caller_max if the live charge is over it; an absolute >=$1000/call trap trips AVOID regardless

samples.description: optional reliability burst: sample the 402 challenge N times (1-5) for settle-consistency + latency; default 1

tools.name: x402_receipt_verify
tools.description: Did my x402 payment actually settle? POST-payment on-chain proof — the other half of x402_preflight (which checks BEFORE paying). Bring your Base settlement tx hash + the resource URL you paid, and this reads the tx receipt from Base mainnet, decodes its USDC Transfer events, and reconciles them against the endpoint's advertised payTo + amount (resolved from the resource's live 402, or pass payto/expect to bind it directly). Returns verdict SETTLED | UNDERPAID | WRONG_RECIPIENT | NO_TRANSFER | REVERTED | NOT_FOUND | UNVERIFIED, the matched transfer, and all USDC transfers in the tx. Read-only ground truth; confirms settlement to the right address + amount, not off-chain resource delivery. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on MCP tools/call (direct HTTP route: $0.004).

url.description: the x402 resource URL you paid — its live 402 challenge supplies the advertised payTo + amount to reconcile against

payto.description: optional: 0x payTo to reconcile against directly (binds the check without fetching the endpoint)

expect.description: optional: advertised amount in USDC dollars (e.g. 0.004) to verify the settled amount against

tools.name: x402_receipt_verify_preview
tools.description: FREE keyless x402 settlement check on Base: pass a tx hash plus payto (and optionally expect, in USDC). Dual-RPC reads the receipt, decodes USDC Transfers and returns SETTLED | UNDERPAID | WRONG_RECIPIENT | NO_TRANSFER | REVERTED | NOT_FOUND. Binds to the payTo you supply; resolving the payTo from a live 402 url is the paid x402_receipt_verify.

payto.description: 0x payTo address the payment should have reached

expect.description: optional: advertised amount in USDC dollars (e.g. 0.004)
